slides.texte_overlay:
Small things that make
a man look expensive

1. Clean shoes

People look down
before they look up.

2. A fresh haircut

Every 3 to 4 weeks.
Never let it grow out
by accident.

3. Clothes that fit

A cheap shirt that fits
beats an expensive one
that doesn't.

4. Knowing a little
about a lot

Art, history, the world.
Conversation is the
best accessory.
slides.texte_sophia:
4. Knowing a little
about a lot

Art, history, the world.
I learn one thing a day
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
5. Good posture

Chin level. Shoulders back.
It costs nothing.

6. Speaking slowly

No rush to fill the silence.
Calm sounds confident.

7. A clean car

Inside and out.
It says how you treat
everything else.
